baseline.source_registry_role: Read-only source of the 0.2.7 qualification state; this WP01 record never rewrites it.

policy.promotion_rule: A disposition is planning only. A qualification-state change requires a predeclared scoped case, reproducible evidence, declared tolerance, independent-oracle comparability where required, and an explicit Owner decision.
policy.tolerance_rule: A numeric observable, tolerance and provenance must be frozen before execution. Case-dependent tolerances are allowed only when justified by mesh, formulation and oracle; post-result retuning is forbidden.
